instruction.en: Join the house words to their meanings

pairs.right: a person who pays rent to live in a house
money paid every month to live in a house
the person a thing belongs to

steps.question: Mr. Choudhary had one and a half lakh and a loan of one lakh. How much is that?

questionMeaning.hi: चौधरी के पास डेढ़ लाख थे और एक लाख का क़र्ज़। कुल कितना?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Choudhary ke paas dedh laakh the aur ek laakh ka karz. Kul kitna?

steps.modelAnswer: One and a half lakh plus one lakh is two and a half lakh, fifty thousand less than the price.

modelMeaning.hi: डेढ़ लाख और एक लाख मिलाकर ढाई लाख, जो क़ीमत से पचास हज़ार कम है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Dedh laakh aur ek laakh milaakar dhaai laakh, jo keemat se pachaas hazaar kam hai.

steps.sentence: We pay ___ to the landlord every month.

meaning.hi: हम हर महीने मकान मालिक को किराया देते हैं।
meaning.hinglish: Hum har mahine makaan maalik ko kiraaya dete hain.

steps.question: Kali Ghat is in which city?

questionMeaning.hi: काली घाट किस शहर में है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kali Ghat kis shahar mein hai?
